_note: Words the Portable Companion box says out loud, 2026-10-30. The greeting was written by Claude as test wording, and Dr. O heard it from the box on 2026-10-30 and said "it is a great line", so it stays. The goodnight, didnt_hear and too_many lines are still test wording. Dr. O writes and decides the rest of the lines. Nothing here says anything about the companion's life. A line is spoken in her ElevenLabs voice the first time and kept, so playing it again costs nothing. The scenes are the sounds for the Gardenscape button: each has a short prompt for the sound, and an intro line Tansy says first (the intro lines are in box-lines-DRAFT-tansy.json until Dr. O keeps them; with no intro line the sound plays without one). Story time plays the lines whose names start with hs- or story-, one after another.

lines.greeting: Oh. It is you. Good morning, I suppose.
lines.goodnight: Good night. Do not stay up on my account.
lines.didnt_hear: Speak up. I do not repeat myself for just anyone.
lines.too_many: That is enough talking for one day. Come back tomorrow.

jungle.sound: A dense tropical jungle at dawn, birds calling, insects humming, leaves moving in a light breeze, soft distant rain, no voices, no music

waterfall.sound: A waterfall in a forest, steady falling water, a stream below, a few birds far away, no voices, no music

rain.sound: Gentle steady rain on leaves in a garden, soft drips, a little distant thunder, no voices, no music

night-woods.sound: A quiet forest at night, crickets, an owl calling now and then, a light wind in the trees, no voices, no music
